body.p: With the cancellation herein without prejudice of claim 13, claims 12 and 14-21 are pending in the present application. No new matter has been added. In view of the foregoing amendments and the following remarks, it is respectfully submitted that all the pending claims are allowable, and reconsideration is respectfully requested.
Applicant thanks the Examiner for considering the previously filed Information Disclosure Statements and the references cited therein.
II. Rejection of Claims 12 and 14-21 Under 35 U.S.C. k 112

Claims 12 and 14-21 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112 as to definiteness. The claims have been amended herein without prejudice, thereby rendering the definiteness rejection moot. Withdrawal of the definiteness rejection of claims 12 and 14-21 is therefore respectfully requested.
III. Rejection of Claims 12 and 14-21 Under 35 U.S.C. F 103

Claims 12 and 14-21 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as unpatentable over the combination of U.S. Pat. App. Pub. Nos. 2004/0093145 ("Tanimichi"), ("Limbacher"), and ("Filev"). Independent claims 12, 20, and 21 have been amended herein without prejudice to better define the speed range, distance buffer, distance limit, safety distance, and distance target, and certain conditions under which an acceleration target value is set and under which acceleration is system-controlled in a particular way when an operating element is being manipulated for speed control. The cited references do not disclose these amended features. The combination of Tanimichi, Limbacher, and Filev therefore does not disclose or suggest all of the features of any of claims 12, 20, and 21 and therefore does render unpatentable any of claims 12, 20, and 21 or any of claims 14-19, which depend from claim 12. Withdrawal of the obviousness rejection of claims 12 and 14-21 is therefore respectfully requested.

All issues raised having been addressed, it is therefore respectfully requested that the rejections be withdrawn. Prompt reconsideration and allowance of the present application are therefore earnestly solicited.
